parameters.query:
SELECT nombre AS "Nombre", numero_whatsapp AS "Numero_Whatsapp"
FROM msp_cache.cache_tecnicos
WHERE activo = true
ORDER BY nombre;

SELECT
  ticketid, ticket_no, title, status, solution,
  empresa, cliente_asignado, tecnico_asignado
FROM msp_cache.cache_tickets
WHERE status IN ('Open', 'In Progress', 'Wait', 'Coordinated', 'Pending')
  AND NOT deleted
  AND createdtime >= '2026-01-01'
ORDER BY ticketid ASC
